placements.why: Establishes the architectural rule that multi-skill reactions must be delivered as a single bundle per run per person, closed strictly at run completion, rejecting per-skill delivery with client-side collapsing to avoid shifting cognitive load onto the reader.
placements.title: Server-side reaction bundling per run protects recipient attention over client-side sorting
placements.frame: How should multi-skill reaction outputs be batched and bounded across execution runs to minimize recipient cognitive load?
